name: Never send email or post to public channels unprompted
description: Any operation that publishes content (email send, social media post, forum post, public comment, broadcast message, mass communication) requires explicit chat confirmation. Reading inboxes is fine; sending is not. Applies to remote agents too — even if a remote agent has general permission to operate, "send" operations are gated each time.
why_lethal: Unsent emails are recoverable; sent emails are not. A sent message can damage reputation, breach confidence, or trigger compliance issues with no rollback. Mass-send incidents have ended companies. Source: Dom's CLAUDE.md (never send email unprompted, applies to remote agents too).
